meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (Unitary National Jurisdiction, International Companies Registry)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (English common law, equity and statute adopted under Article 95(2) of the Constitution of the Republic of Vanuatu 1980, as modified by Vanuatu legislation; residual French civil law influence in limited matters)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act No. 34 of 2015 (as amended and consolidated, Cap. 222); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2014 (as consolidated); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Regulations Order No. 72 of 2015; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act No. 10 of 2000; Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit framework (Financial Intelligence Unit Act); VFSC AML/CFT Guidelines for International Companies, International Trusts and Company and Trust Service Providers (as revised); VFSC Code of Conduct and Corporate Governance Guidelines applicable to registered agents.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport of each beneficial owner (25% or greater interest) and all directors
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority of country of origin (e.g., National Passport Office)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Vanuatu is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention 1961; documents for use in Vanuatu must be notarized, certified by the competent national authority, and legalized by the Vanuatu diplomatic/consular post or, where none exists, by the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Port Vila)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Incumbency of any corporate shareholder (parent entity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registrar or licensed corporate services provider in the country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (notarial certification of the corporate registry certificate followed by legalization by competent Vanuatu consular authority)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference letter and source-of-funds declaration for each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing financial institution (settling or reference bank)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (signature of bank officer notarized and authenticated through the applicable consular chain for Vanuatu)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential or trading address of each UBO/director (utility bill, bank statement or government-issued correspondence)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider, bank, or issuing government authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (certified true copy pathway applicable since Vanuatu does not recognize apostilles)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional or employer reference letter supporting corporate record and beneficial ownership narrative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Accountant, lawyer, or licensed professional employer in the document's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (notarization followed by chain legalization at the relevant Vanuatu accredited diplomatic mission)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based customer due diligence under the AML/CFT Act No. 13 of 2014 and VFSC AML/CFT Guidelines for Company and Trust Service Providers. Every shareholder, director, UBO and signatory must be screened at establishment and re-screened at least annually (and on any material change) against: the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit domestic warning and watch lists; the OFAC SDN List; the UN Consolidated Sanctions List; the EU Consolidated List; UK consolidated (FCDO/OFSI) sanctions; and commercial PEP databases covering international politically exposed persons, their family members and close associates. Positive PEP hits trigger enhanced due diligence, evidenced source-of-wealth documentation, senior management approval and ongoing enhanced transaction monitoring. Suspicious transactions must be reported to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit in accordance with Section 32 of the AML/CFT Act; failure to comply exposes the registered agent and its principals to civil and criminal liability under Vanuatu law.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - International Companies Registry, Online Company Name Search and Reservation Portal (e-VFSC / VRS electronic lodgement system)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be registered in Latin (Roman) script, using the official languages of the Republic of Vanuatu, namely English, French or Bislama. No indigenous non-Latin script is prescribed; transliteration into ASCII characters is applied for diacritics. The name must include a mandatory legal suffix identifying limited liability: 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp', 'Société Anonyme' or 'S.A.'. The name may not be the same as or confusingly similar to an existing Vanuatu or foreign company name on the VFSC register, and may not suggest a domestic (Vanuatu-taxed) company status for an International Company.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon written rejection from the Registrar of International Companies (VFSC), the applicant or its registered agent may, within 14 days of the rejection notice, file a written administrative appeal with the International Companies Registry accompanied by: (i) a copy of the proposed name and the rejection letter; (ii) legal grounds and supporting evidence (e.g., prior acquainting use, letters of consent from an existing holder, distinction of business nature/geography); and (iii) one or more alternative names to be considered in the alternative. The VFSC shall determine the appeal and notify the applicant in writing within 15 business days of receipt. Any further adverse decision may be challenged by way of judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the procedural rules of the Civil Procedure Rules 2002.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office address is not permissible as the statutory registered office in Vanuatu. The International Companies Act No. 34 of 2015 requires a registered office physically located in Vanuatu, provided by a VFSC-licensed registered agent, where statutory records, statutory notices and process are physically accessible. For this low-risk collectible trading card publishing business, a co-working or serviced physical office in Port Vila may, however, be used as the operational trading address for payment processor (Stripe, Authorize.Net), banking and commercial correspondence purposes, provided it is distinct from the statutory registered office and is disclosed consistently in substantive documentation.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low risk: estimated annual probability of unannounced physical on-site VFSC inspection is below 5% for a low-risk Standard-tier non-licensed trading card publisher. VFSC compliance supervision for this classification is primarily document-based, but the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act and AML/CFT Act permit authorized officers to conduct unannounced inspections, request books and records, and verify registered office presence. Maintaining a functional physical office address and continuously holding original or certified corporate records at the registered agent's premises is therefore mandatory.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1992 (Cap. 222), as amended — ss. 4 (registration), 6 (memorandum), 7 (articles), 10 (certificate of incorporation) and 38 (tax exemption); Companies Act 1986 (Cap. 191) applies subsidiarily for matters not inconsistent with the International Companies Act.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Registry of International Companies
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1 — Application for Registration as an International Company, together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association, Declaration of Compliance and Consent of Registered Agent
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital or escrow deposit is required under the International Companies Act 1992; a nominal authorized capital of one ordinary share of USD 1.00 (or equivalent in another currency) suffices.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION — INTERNATIONAL CARD PRINTING LIMITED

1. Ratification of Incorporation: The Board ratifies incorporation under the International Companies Act 1992 (Cap. 222) and adopts the Memorandum and Articles of Association filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission.
2. Share Subscription: The subscriber’s application to subscribe one ordinary share at par is approved; no paid-up capital deposit is required by statute.
3. Registered Office: The registered office at Port Vila and the VFSC-licensed registered agent are adopted as the Company’s statutory seat and agent.
4. Officer Appointments: The founding subscriber is appointed sole Director and Corporate Secretary, with authority to manage the Company’s trading-card business.
5. Authorizations: The Director is authorized to open bank accounts, appoint service providers, execute the overseas holographic-printing subcontract, and file all regulatory documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Clearance and Corporate Structure Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Corporate Registry via a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent (online portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the VFSC-licensed registered agent to submit a name search and reservation for the proposed entity with the mandatory 'Limited' suffix, together with two alternative names; concurrently confirm the director and shareholder KYC pack and the one-share capital structure.
required_dossiers: Name reservation form (first choice plus two alternative names)
Passport copy and proof of residential address (utility bill) for each director and shareholder
Bank reference letter for each ultimate beneficial owner
AML/KYC questionnaire of the licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused or is reserved by another entity, an immediate substituted name filing is accepted by VFSC within 3 business days without additional state fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed Registered Agent and Vanuatu Notary Public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association in the statutory form prescribed by the International Companies Act 1992, execute Form 1 Application, and have all execution pages notarized or certified by the licensed agent and notary before filing.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (one-share company draft)
Form 1 – Application for Registration as an International Company
Declaration of Compliance signed by the registered agent
Consent to Act as Registered Agent and Registered Office consent
Executed KYC pack and corporate profile
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Defects in notarial certification are cured administratively by re-issue of a certified copy; any drafting inconsistency in the Articles is rectified by a supplementary board resolution prior to filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application to VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC – Registry of International Companies, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the complete application pack via the registered agent’s secure VFSC portal, pay the official state fee of approximately USD 800 by electronic transfer, and request expedited same-day processing if required by the founding board.
required_dossiers: Completed Form 1 and executed constitutional documents from Step 2
Registered agent’s Declaration of Compliance
VFSC state fee payment remittance receipt
Power of attorney authorizing the agent to file on behalf of the subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC issues a requisition, respond in writing within 14 days; where the application is refused, amend the Memorandum and Articles or change the company name and resubmit with a fresh Form 1, with no re-imposition of the full state fee for administrative amendments.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Establishment of Statutory Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC (issuance); VFSC-licensed Registered Agent (maintenance of registers)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Collect the Certificate of Incorporation, verify the company number and date of incorporation, open the statutory registers of members, directors, and charges, issue the share certificate to the subscriber, and prepare the optional common seal. The International Company is outside the Vanuatu revenue system and requires no stamp duty or re-registration.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Statutory registers of members, directors, secretary, and charges
Share certificate and register of share transfers
Registered agent certification of good standing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: A clerical discrepancy in the Certificate is cured by filing a correction application with VFSC, supported by a declaration from the registered agent, processed within 3 business days at a nominal fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Exemption Confirmation, Banking and Operating Architecture
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC; Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR) for exemption confirmation; international banking institution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the standard International Company Tax Exemption confirmation letter evidencing zero percent taxation under s. 38 of the International Companies Act 1992; open a corporate account with an international bank; execute subcontract manufacturing and publishing agreements with overseas holographic foil-printing plants; calendar the VFSC annual return and annual fee obligations due each June 30.
required_dossiers: Certified Certificate of Incorporation and Memorandum and Articles of Association
Board resolution appointing bank signatories
International Company tax exemption confirmation letter
Registered agent certificate of good standing
Subcontract printing agreement and IP assignment schedule
AML/KYC forms of the collecting bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DCIR or the bank challenges the exemption, deliver the s. 38 statutory exemption certificate and a written legal opinion from the registered agent; bank admissibility issues are cured by completing enhanced due diligence, including a source-of-funds letter.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – Business Licence Office (BLO) under the Business Licence Act 1998 (Cap. 229), in conjunction with the Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) for any future foreign investor physical establishment
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Vanuatu Business Licence (Business Licence Act 1998) — currently not triggered because the International Company conducts all holographic printing and publishing outside Vanuatu through offshore subcontractors; if a physical printing plant is later established onshore, a Business Licence and Foreign Investment Approval Certificate would become mandatory

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Energy, Environment and National Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Environmental Registration (Category B — low-risk) under the Environmental Protection and Conservation Act 2002 (ss. 20-34); a full EIA Study is required only for a future onshore solvent-based printing facility exceeding medium-scale thresholds; the current offshore subcontracting model is exempt from local EIA
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No onshore discharge arises under the offshore model. If a Vanuatu plant is established: zero discharge of untreated process wastewater; effluent pH 6.0-9.0; BOD5 ≤ 50 mg/L; TSS ≤ 50 mg/L; VOC extraction and carbon adsorption with ≥ 90% capture efficiency; hazardous solvent and foil waste segregated and exported to an authorized recycler under a DEPC movement permit; no landfill disposal.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable to the current offshore subcontracting model. If onshore premises are established: fire safety certificate from the Vanuatu Fire Service (Ministry of Internal Affairs); structural load inspection certificate for the printing warehouse; and workplace occupational safety and health clearance under the Employment Act (Cap. 160) and the designated OSH inspectorate, including chemical storage bunding, emergency evacuation drills, and fire extinguishing system certification.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; Department of Finance and Treasury (tax policy and revenue administration); Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue (customs duties, excise, and stamp duties); Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) as the regulator of International Companies. Official portals: www.finance.gov.vu, www.vfsc.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Vanuatu does not operate an income tax system and does not issue tax identification numbers for income tax purposes. A foreign-owned International Company (IC) is constituted by a Registered Agent under the International Companies Act [Cap 222], and the VFSC issues a Certificate of Incorporation and a company registration number. No separate TIN or VAT ID is required. If the IC imports or exports physical goods, it must obtain a customs importer/exporter code from Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue by filing a customs registration application together with the certificate of incorporation, registered agent confirmation, and principal place of business information. A provincial Business Licence may be required if the IC carries on physical business within Vanuatu, but that is a licensing matter and not a tax registration procedure.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu law does not provide a check-the-box system or any domestic hybrid mismatch election. An International Company is automatically exempt from Vanuatu income tax, corporate tax, withholding tax, capital gains tax, stamp duty, and any future direct tax, pursuant to the International Companies Act. The company may, in its constitutional documents, elect to operate as an exempt International Company and prohibit domestic business activities in Vanuatu. Foreign tax classification of the IC is purely determined by the investor‘s home jurisdiction rules for controlled foreign companies, CFC look-through, or entity transparency; Vanuatu makes no domestic election available for such treatment.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None — Vanuatu has no VAT, no GST, and no general sales or use tax. The only indirect levies are customs import duties, selective excise duties, stamp duties, and tourism promotion levy. No consumption tax registration obligation exists.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — no VAT/GST registration threshold exists. For customs purposes, any importer or exporter must obtain a Customs Importer/Exporter Code irrespective of turnover. For physical business activity within Vanuatu, a provincial Business Licence is required; there is no statutory turnover threshold for tax registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic fiscal invoice, real-time clearance, digital stamping, or API-based tax clearance mandate applies in Vanuatu because no VAT/GST system exists. Customs processing is performed electronically through the ASYCUDA World single-window system for export and import declarations, and customs duties are settled before clearance. There is no requirement to transmit invoices to any tax authority.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable in Vanuatu. Since Vanuatu does not impose VAT, there is no domestic mechanism for zero-rating exports or for claiming input VAT export refunds. All exports of collectible trading cards and similar goods are outside the Vanuatu indirect tax net. If the goods are exported from Vanuatu, customs export entry is required; no local tax zero-rating approval or refund application procedure applies.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA export entry) — mandatory for physical export
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill — mandatory to evidence international transport
Commercial Invoice and Packing List — mandatory for customs valuation and description of goods
Inward Remittance Certificate — not required under Vanuatu exchange control or customs law, but may be included in the export dossier for banks or foreign tax authority substantiation
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: There is no Vanuatu VAT zero-rating clawback because no VAT benefit exists. However, false customs declarations, misdescription of goods, or under-valuation in an export entry may subject the exporter to penalties under the Customs and Excise Act, including monetary fines, forfeiture of goods, imposition of additional duties, and, in serious cases, criminal prosecution. Records supporting customs declarations should be retained for at least seven years and made available to Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue upon request. Since Vanuatu imposes no exchange controls, no statutory FX repatriation deadline applies; the 180-day period stated in this dossier is a placeholder reflecting international best practice and may be imposed by foreign tax or banking regulations rather than Vanuatu law.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu operates a floating exchange-rate regime with no material current-account exchange controls. The vatu is fully convertible for current-account transactions, including proceeds from the sale of collectible trading cards and direct trade-related payments. Capital-account transactions of an International Company are largely unrestricted under the International Companies Act, and profit or capital remittances to non-resident shareholders are lawful without prior regulatory approval. The principal practical hurdles relate to banking-level source-of-funds checks and counterparty confirmation rather than statutory exchange-control limits.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu does not impose an export-proceeds surrender obligation and there is no statutory timeline for repatriation or mandatory conversion ratio for export receipts. The RBV prescribes anti-money-laundering screening on all inward remittances; once cleared, proceeds are freely credited to the International Company's domestic account and may be retained in VUV or converted at the prevailing market rate.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational VUV and USD Account
Operational VUV/USD Account and Trade Settlement Account
Operational Corporate Account and Short-Term Treasury Facility

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Offshore digital EMI providers are not licensed or supervised by the RBV and cannot operate as direct settlement institutions in Vanuatu. Crediting proceeds from an unlicensed EMI into a local Vanuatu bank account is operationally possible only after complete transparency on the originator and underlying commercial transaction. Legal feasibility is restricted by the RBV's AML/CFT licensing framework, which requires any entity providing payment services or money transmission to hold a licensed financial institution status in Vanuatu. Therefore, a licensed physical Vanuatu commercial bank account is mandatory for the treasury and clearing backbone.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandatory for initial account opening. RBV AML/CFT Guidelines require a face-to-face verification of signatories and beneficial owners for corporate accounts. Select accredited introducers may perform the identity interview on behalf of a bank, but the onboarding bank ultimately requires the original identity documents, apostilled corporate records, and a board resolution authorizing the account mandate. Fully remote account opening without any in-person KYC step is not viable under current Vanuatu practice.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: International Company lacking audited financial statements and having no local substance footprint
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation, certificate of good standing from the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, statutory declaration of no audit requirement under the International Companies Act, management accounts, and a letter of explanation of the offshore trading-card publishing and printing business model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Potential bearer share issuance or incomplete beneficial-ownership chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full UBO statutory declaration, certified share register, board resolution identifying all shareholders and connected parties, certified copies of passports, and a legal opinion from a Vanuatu-licensed counsel confirming that no bearer shares are outstanding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transaction velocity mismatch between high-frequency card sales and modest local administrative footprint
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master distribution agreements with TCG publishers, licensing agreements for holographic and cold-foil printing, inventory records, third-party logistics waybills, pro forma invoices, and a monthly treasury reconciliation showing that transaction flows match commercial contracts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and PEP screening alerts triggered by similar-name matches in Pacific-region lists
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed PEP/sanctions self-declaration forms, certified passport and national ID, an independent background screening report from a recognized global compliance provider, and a short written KYC risk assessment prepared by a Vanuatu compliance adviser.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Suspected round-tripping or misuse of Vanuatu zero-tax status for non-trade-related capital flows
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited or management-prepared financial statements, transaction flow chart, underlying sales invoices and printing supply contracts, tax residence certificate issued by the Vanuatu authorities, and a corporate tax opinion confirming that the International Company is tax-exempt only on properly documented foreign-source commercial income.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital contributions from non-resident shareholders are routed via SWIFT MT103 or MT202 from the shareholder's bank to the Vanuatu commercial bank account. The settlement instruction must clearly state 'Equity Capital Contribution — International Company VU_IC' and cite the business purpose of ISIC 3240 printing and trading-card publishing. No prior RBV approval is required, but the receiving bank will perform AML/UFC screening and may require the shareholder to provide recent bank statements, source-of-wealth, and a certification of the capital injection from the board. Crediting is normally completed within one to two business days after compliance clearance.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlement for printing supplies, raw stock, and overseas logistics is executed through standard foreign exchange clearing rails: SWIFT MT103 direct bank remittances for supplier payments; MT103/MT202 paired messages for intermediary-cleared payments; documentary collection with issuing banks for higher-risk transactions; and commercial letters of credit under UCP600 when the overseas supplier requires bank-payment certainty. For each outbound disbursement the Vanuatu bank requires the underlying invoice, the purchase order, and the shipping documentation sufficient to demonstrate a genuine trade settlement.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanuatu vatu / US dollar outright forward contracts with a licensed RBV commercial bank
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on VUV where a Vanuatu bank transacts with a recognized offshore foreign-exchange counterparty
Cross-currency swaps involving VUV and major convertible currencies executed with an RBV-licensed banking counterparty

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government License Renewal Fee for International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary of incorporation date each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment incurs a VUV 15,000 penalty; continued non-payment for 90 days permits VFSC to issue a strike-off notice and dissolve the company administratively, with directors jointly liable for debts incurred after dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return Confirmation (International Company Form IC-AR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 45 days after each anniversary of registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file attracts a VUV 25,000 fine; after two consecutive defaults, the Registrar may strike the company off the register, causing loss of legal personality and forfeiture of assets to the Government.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Registered Agent (on file with VFSC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On each anniversary date of incorporation or within 60 days after any share transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-submission triggers a VUV 100,000 monetary penalty against the registered agent; uncorrected omissions within 180 days subject the company to suspension of voting and dividend rights and administrative strike-off proceedings.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A standard Vanuatu International Company is exempt from mandatory external audit unless it engages in regulated activities licensed by VFSC (banking, insurance, insurance intermediation, or securities dealing), elects public-company status under the International Companies Act, or exceeds gross annual revenue of VUV 150 million (approximately USD 1.2 million), in which case an IFRS-based independent audit is required.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) or IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities; Vanuatu has no codified national GAAP for International Companies, and accounts may be prepared in accordance with internationally accepted accounting standards.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annually, every shareholder and beneficial owner (including any intermediary nominee or trust chain) must execute and deliver a signed Beneficial Ownership Declaration to the Vanuatu Registered Agent. The agent must maintain the UBO register in the statutory books and file a consolidated confirmation of beneficial ownership records with VFSC on each annual-return anniversary. A transfer of shares is not registrable unless the UBO update is completed within 60 days of the transfer.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: No statutory audit required for a standard dormant International Company; if an audit is triggered, the typical certified audit fee ranges between USD 1,500 and USD 4,500.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% - Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax on any company, including International Companies; the exemption is anchored in Section 20 of the International Companies Act (Cap. 222).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Permanent 0% effective rate for International Companies. No income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, estate duty, or stamp duty on IC instruments. The sole recurring fiscal charge is the annual VFSC government fee (approximately VUV 30,000 per annum, adjusted by VFSC fee regulations) plus the licensed registered agent fee. VAT at 12.5% applies only to taxable supplies of goods and services physically supplied in Vanuatu and to certain imported services under reverse charge; it does not apply to offshore collectible-trading-card publishing revenue.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return and Annual Government Fee - International Company (International Companies Act, Cap. 222; filed via the VFSC ePortal)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on the anniversary of incorporation; payment must be remitted within 30 days after the anniversary date. Strike-off proceedings may commence if fees remain unpaid for 3 to 6 months.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unique VFSC company number (ICV series) assigned at incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the certificate number issued to the IC; do not use the agent's internal reference.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact registered name with the designation International Company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any trading name used on card packaging or payment pages must be separately registered with VFSC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name of the licensed Vanuatu-registered agent and the registered office address in Port Vila.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent must be a VFSC-licensed entity; a foreign management office cannot substitute.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Current director(s), shareholder(s), and share allotment details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident individuals or corporate directors are permitted; bearer shares are prohibited.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Individual(s) owning or controlling more than 25% of the IC, including via nominee arrangements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose the ultimate natural person; failure is treated as a false filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation of whether the IC conducts a relevant activity requiring Vanuatu substance.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A card-publishing entity holding character art or brand IP should declare the IP business and distribution activity, not claim passive status without analysis.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Payment of the annual VFSC government fee.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No CIT computation is required; no profit or turnover declaration is made to VFSC.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment triggers a statutory surcharge of 10% of the annual fee plus daily default penalties; continued default results in strike-off and deregistration, with reinstatement fees and potential personal liability of the registered agent.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance Declaration for International Companies (ESR Annual Filing via VFSC ePortal)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 12 months after the reporting financial year-end; VFSC practice requires alignment to 31 December unless a different period is approved in writing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Financial year start and end dates covered by the declaration.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident groups may use the parent fiscal year with prior VFSC approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selection of banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, holding company, intellectual property business, or distribution and service centre.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Collectible-trading-card operations typically select intellectual property business for brand and artwork monetisation and distribution and service centre for product sales.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Core Income Generating Activities (CIGA) in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Narrative of strategic management, contractual execution, and operational decisions performed in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cannot state that all decisions occur abroad; pass-through substance is treated as non-compliance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Address of premises, number of employees, and annual operating expenditure incurred in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A serviced office at the agent's premises is acceptable only when demonstrably adequate for the stated activity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Director countersignature confirming accuracy of substance details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Knowingly false declarations constitute a criminal offence with personal exposure.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Administrative fines per contravention, daily default fines, mandatory exchange of information with OECD and EU competent authorities, deregistration, and prosecution of directors for false declarations.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on dividends distributed by an International Company to non-resident or resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double tax agreement network, so no DTA relief application is needed: the domestic source withholding rate is already zero and applies automatically at the time of distribution. Where a foreign jurisdiction demands proof of Vanuatu residence, the shareholder or IC applies through the licensed agent to the Ministry of Finance and Economic Management for a Certificate of Residence or Certificate of Good Standing; supported by incorporation records, register extracts, and beneficial ownership details. No Tax Residency Certificate regime exists within the IC Act, and Vanuatu does not require advance approval for dividend remittances.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding on outbound royalties for character art, trademarks, and IP licences, and 0% on debt interest. Vanuatu has no deemed-distribution, thin-capitalisation, or excess-interest rules applicable to International Companies. Recipients remain taxable in their own residence jurisdiction; no Vanuatu treaty relief is necessary. Imported services used by the IC may attract Vanuatu VAT at 12.5% under reverse charge.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable (VUV 0) - Vanuatu domestic law prescribes no transfer pricing documentation regime, no Local File, no Master File, and no transactional threshold for International Companies. Related-party pricing should nevertheless be arm's length and documented to OECD BEPS standards because the ESR administrative process and foreign tax authorities may scrutinise the IC.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Companies (Economic Substance) framework, as amended in 2021 and 2022, applies to ICs performing relevant activities: banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, holding company, intellectual property business, and distribution and service centres. A collectible-trading-card publisher that holds brand art and exploits it through remote sales is typically in scope for both the IP business and the distribution and service centre categories. Compliance requires: (i) management and control in Vanuatu; (ii) adequate physical premises, employees, and local expenditure; (iii) core income generating activities performed in Vanuatu; and (iv) an annual substance declaration filed with VFSC. A purely passive IC may remain outside the relevant-activity scope but must file to evidence that non-activity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Prohibited Domestic Business and Trading with Vanuatu Residents
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC sells collectible trading cards to Vanuatu-resident consumers via Stripe or Authorize.Net, leases retail or office premises directly in Port Vila, or employs Vanuatu residents outside the licensed registered-agent channel, without converting to a domestic company under the Companies Act 2009.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Offence under the International Companies Act (Cap. 222): offending transactions are void against the IC, fines are imposed on the company and each officer, and VFSC may order strike-off. Unlicensed local business operations additionally trigger VAT registration obligations at 12.5%, customs duties, and separate criminal penalties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly permit resident dealings face personal fines, disqualification, deregistration, and personal liability for corporate debts arising from the prohibited course of business.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Economic Substance Failure and Shell Company Doctrine
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC holds valuable trading-card art and brand IP, books distribution income, but has no Vanuatu premises, no local directors, conducts all core income generating activities through foreign subcontractors, and files no ESR declaration. This is the most common zero-tax trap for marketed Vanuatu ICs.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR administrative penalties per contravention, daily default fines, mandatory information exchange with foreign and OECD or EU authorities, deregistration, and loss of the Section 20 tax-exemption protection as the legal fiction is disregarded. The IC may be re-characterised as a tax resident elsewhere for all open periods.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Officers signing false substance declarations face criminal fines and imprisonment on conviction; directors may be disqualified from acting on any VFSC-regulated entity, and foreign courts may appraise taxes, interest, and penalties personally against directors under anti-avoidance rules.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False Statements, Fraud, and Fraudulent Trading
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Submitting false shareholder or beneficial-ownership information to VFSC, misrepresenting the IC as having Vanuatu substance, or continuing to invoice trading-card customers while the company is struck off the register.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal offence under the IC Act: monetary fine and term of imprisonment, strike-off, forfeiture of filings, and reinstatement only by Court order after payment of all penalties. Creditors may petition for winding up and demand restitution of misapplied assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced: directors and officers are personally liable for restitution of dissipated corporate assets and court costs; travel restrictions may be imposed while enforcement is pending, with custodial sentences for fraudulent trading.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CTF Breach and Unlicensed Financial Dealing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating card-payment flows through a nominee payment processor to conceal the IC's merchant identity, accumulating large volumes of card transactions without transaction monitoring, or providing escrow, stored-value, or wallet functions that fall within the Financial Dealers Licensing Act (Cap. 70).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Unlicensed financial dealing is an offence under Cap. 70 with fines, imprisonment, asset forfeiture, and VFSC licence revocation. The Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2018 imposes customer due diligence, record-keeping, and reporting duties on reporting entities; breach attracts regulatory penalties and civil recovery.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal fines, disgorgement of processing proceeds, travel bans during investigation, and imprisonment in aggravated cases; merchant accounts are terminated and chargeback losses are recovered personally where nominee arrangements are proven.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Beneficial Ownership and Annual Fee Non-Compliance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to maintain and file beneficial ownership information, or failure to pay the annual VFSC government fee for successive years while the TGC entity continues to transact through Stripe or Authorize.Net.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC imposes late-payment surcharges, suspends the IC from transacting, strikes the company off the International Register after notice, and reports non-compliance to foreign tax authorities under the exchange-of-information framework. Reinstatement requires a Court order plus payment of all unpaid fees and penalties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors remain statutorily liable for the IC's debts contracted during the non-compliant period, face monetary penalties, may be barred from acting as directors of any Vanuatu entity, and travel bans may issue for outstanding VFSC obligations.
